name: dc-el_alamein-coop-realfire-rec
description: dc-el_alamein-coop-rec with lab/realfire's realfire.so beside the recorder: every bot shot is a real projectile (a bots-only round otherwise fires fake, AI-134), so tank shells, SMAW/RPG-7, TOW and AT-5 missiles, cannon and MG rounds and the artillery fly where the recorder can measure them. The projectile laws are the engine's; the round itself is not a normal bot round (hits land by flight, not by the AI's dice). Build the preload first: `lab/realfire/build.sh`.
human: No client needed. One round is enough for the flights; then `lab.py stop`.
